page.layout: Running head at top, page number at top right. One column of text, full width. No margin notes. Catchword "varum" at right below the last line.

main_text.head: Admodum Reverendissimo Patri Johanni Morino Cardinalis Barberinus.
main_text.p: GRatum fuit, tua quoque testificatio-ne cognoscere, Abrahamum Ecchel-lensem eam in Bibliis Syriacis recensen-dis istic praestitisse operam, quam & per-specta ejus eruditio pollicebatur, & tan-ti moliminis opus requirebat; sed non minus mihi jucundum accidit, quod il-le vicissim de tuis studiis, & pristino in nos affectu ea retulerit, quae jam pridem scire avebam; nam in iis pertexendis te nunc versari audio, quae, cum apud nos esses, de sacra rituum Ecclesiasticorum antiquitate meditari coeperas; quod quidem argumentum eo te cautius tractaturum existimo, quod indies largo pro-ventu succrescere videas Scriptores, qui nihil ad res sacras tractandas praeter Phi-lautiam, & innovandi pruriginem affe-rentes, Ecclesiae agrum periculosis no-

page.notes: The big initial G is joined to "Ratum" as "GRatum". Long s is written as s throughout. Printed "qv" and "ꝑ" forms were normalised to u (qvoqve, qvod, qvae). "ea" in "affectu ea retulerit" carries a flourish over the a that may be a printed mark, not a letter; read as ea. Catchword "varum" is set at the right below the last line and is kept out of the text.
